Karen Knight

Cornish Independent Nonaligned GroupCamborne West & Treswithian
cllr.karen.knight@cornwall.gov.uk
RSS FeedReport CardCompare

Karen Knight serves as a councillor for the Camborne West & Treswithian ward on Cornwall Council, representing the Cornish Independent Nonaligned Group. In her role she sits on a range of committees, including the Constitution and Governance Committee, the Corporate Finance and Performance Overview and Scrutiny Committee, the Licensing Act Committee and its Sub‑Committee, the Street Trading and Pavement Licensing Sub‑Committee, the Together for Families Overview and Scrutiny Committee, and the West Sub‑Area Planning Committee. She is also a member of the full Cornwall Council body.

During the most recent reporting period Knight attended 16 of 18 council meetings, giving her an attendance rate of 88.9 %. There are no recorded conduct cases against her, and no expense data has been reported. Her record shows zero active red flags and no media mentions.

Knight was elected with 685 votes, securing a majority of 295 votes (17.31 % of the total) over the runner‑up, Zoe Fox of Mebyon Kernow, who received 390 votes. The election vulnerability score assigned to her is 54 out of 100.

Election History

CompetitiveScore: 54/100→ Stable
Won by 295 votes (17.3%)8.7% swing needed to unseat

Councillor Karen Knight was elected with 685 votes, holding a majority of 295 votes (17.31 % of the total) over the runner‑up, Zoe Fox of Mebyon Kernow, who received 390 votes. A swing of roughly 8.66 % would be required for the seat to change hands, and the low turnout of 33.76 % suggests a modest voter base. The vulnerability rating of 54 out of 100 classifies the seat as competitive.
